blocks.explanation:
Fraction proper hai, lekin neeche ek quadratic \(x^2 + 7x + 10\) hai. Pehle dekhna hai ke yeh toot-ta hai ya nahi; yeh \((x + 2)(x + 5)\) ban jata hai, to kul teen mukhtalif linear factors: Case I.
Humein teen constants chahiyein.
Plan: quadratic ke factors, identity, teen zeros rakhna, coefficients compare, aur jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{3x^2 - 4x - 5}{(x - 2)(x^2 + 7x + 10)}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Pehle denominator ke poore factors banayein. Agar sirf mukhtalif linear factors bachein to Case I lagta hai. Quadratic ko bina check kiye \(\frac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 7x + 10}\) likh dena kaam to karta hai lekin lamba aur ghalat-faihmi wala raasta hai.

Check karein ke fraction proper hai
Upar degree 2, neeche degree 3.
Kyun: \(2 < 3\), is liye division nahi chahiye. Neeche \((x - 2)\) ki degree 1 aur quadratic ki degree 2, jama 3.

Quadratic factor ke factors banayein
\[x^2 + 7x + 10 = (x + 2)(x + 5)\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiyein jin ka zarb 10 aur jama 7 ho: woh 2 aur 5 hain. Yaani yeh quadratic irreducible (na tootne wala) nahi hai, is liye isay todna zaroori hai.

Shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{3x^2 - 4x - 5}{(x - 2)(x + 2)(x + 5)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 2} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2} + \dfrac{C}{x + 5}\]
Kyun: Teen mukhtalif linear factors, har ek ka ek fraction.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[3x^2 - 4x - 5 = A(x + 2)(x + 5)\]
\[+ B(x - 2)(x + 5)\]
\[+ C(x - 2)(x + 2) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x - 2)(x + 2)(x + 5)\) se multiply kiya; har constant ke saath baaqi do factors.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 2\) rakhein
\[12 - 8 - 5 = A(4)(7)\]
\[-1 = 28A\]
\[A = -\tfrac{1}{28}\]
Kyun: \(x = 2\) par \(x - 2 = 0\), sirf \(A\) wala term bachta hai. Baayen taraf \(3(4) - 4(2) - 5 = -1\).

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -2\) rakhein
\[12 + 8 - 5 = B(-4)(3)\]
\[15 = -12B\]
\[B = -\tfrac{5}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x + 2 = 0\) par sirf \(B\) bachta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(3(-2)^2 = +12\) (square hamesha musbat) aur \(-4(-2) = +8\). Students yahan aksar \(-8\) likh dete hain.

\(C\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -5\) rakhein
\[75 + 20 - 5 = C(-7)(-3)\]
\[90 = 21C\]
\[C = \tfrac{30}{7}\]
Kyun: \(x + 5 = 0\) par sirf \(C\) bachta hai. \(\tfrac{90}{21}\) ko 3 se kaat kar \(\tfrac{30}{7}\) milta hai; fraction hamesha choti shakal mein likhein.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ A + B + C = 3\]
\[-\tfrac{1}{28} - \tfrac{35}{28} + \tfrac{120}{28} = \tfrac{84}{28} = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Daayen taraf har bracket ka jora \(x^2\) deta hai, to \(x^2\) ka coefficient \(A + B + C\) hai; baayen taraf \(3x^2\) hai. Teeno fractions ko 28 ke denominator par la kar jama karna aasan hai.

Jawab likhein
\[= -\dfrac{1}{28(x - 2)} + \dfrac{30}{7(x + 5)} - \dfrac{5}{4(x + 2)}\]
Kyun: Teenon constants shakal mein rakh diye (answer key wali tarteeb mein). Fractions ki tarteeb badalne se jawab nahi badalta.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\(28(x - 2)(x + 2)(x + 5)\) par numerator:
\[-(x^2 + 7x + 10) - 35(x^2 + 3x - 10)\]
\[+ 120(x^2 - 4)\]
\[= 84x^2 - 112x - 140\]
\[= 28(3x^2 - 4x - 5)\]
To jama asal fraction hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: \(28A = -1\), \(28B = -35\), \(28C = 120\). Sab kuch 28 par la kar jora, aur 28 upar neeche cancel ho gaya.
